text: The comparison covers four project-level lists, not the entire national budget.
A House-only or NEP-only row can reflect renaming, regrouping, scope changes, or unmatched text.
A House-only row is a documentary review lead, not proof of an insertion, authorship, motive, or wrongdoing.
Held and scope-review rows remain quarantined and are not promoted as findings.
The release does not yet compare Senate, bicameral, enacted GAA, release, procurement, payment, or implementation stages.
BetterGov performed the row extraction and initial comparison; Busisi validates schemas, hashes, arithmetic, and control totals.
Three NEP annex extracts lack original-source URLs in the source manifest, although their archived bytes and hashes are retained.
Document amounts are proposed authority, not releases, obligations, payments, final costs, or outcomes.
